Maya (CS): heads-up — i'm drafting a compact customer-facing runbook: onboarding + renewal risk mitigation that customers can use to tune caching, batching, streaming. want a quick sanity check before i publish (:30 min read max).
Alex (CS Ops): love it. can we include a tiny decision tree for small vs. large tenants? most requests are from smaller tenants hitting bursty spikes.
Maya (CS): yes — plan is 3 sections: prefill/warmup, live batching rules, graceful stream fallbacks. + one-pager checklist for renewal conversations.
Jordan (SRE): add an ops-safe snippet for client-side exponential backoff + jitter for prefill calls. also note limits to avoid accidental thundering herd.
Priya (Solutions Eng): +1. sample prefilling curl + suggestion to run a lightweight warm pool during business hours. snippet:```bash
# client prefill example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"ACME","templates":["welcome","faq"]}'
```
Sam (PM): can we add an explicit renewal-risk signal set? e.g., sustained error rate > 3% for 24h OR average latency > 2x SLO for 6h. those map to CS playbook triggers.
Maya (CS): yes. i'll surface three tiers: green/yellow/red and example slack alerts: `#cs-alerts` + `@oncall-sre`. also include recommended escalation steps per tier.
Alex (CS Ops): for batching, suggest client-side batching window 10-50ms for low-latency apps, 200-500ms for high-throughput internal jobs. include a config example for SDK:```json
{"batch": {"max_delay_ms": 50, "max_tokens": 1024}}
```
Priya (Solutions Eng): streaming fallback guidance: prefer chunked streaming when interactive; fallback to short-polling with cached partial responses when connection fails. include a small flowchart text: "stream -> if connection error -> attempt resume -> if resume fails -> fallback to cached summary + enqueue full gen async"
Jordan (SRE): add ops-safe cache eviction guidance: TTLs per tenant based on churn, and a circuit-breaker that disables shared cache for noisy tenants. note: do NOT recommend global unlimited cache.
Maya (CS): capturing feedback loop: short post-onboard survey link + telemetry keys we can request from customers: `onboard.prefill.success_rate`, `prefill.latency.p95`, `stream.resume_attempts`. include sample query for telemetry dashboard.
Sam (PM): also include a one-click checklist CS can send to customers before renewals: warm pools set, prefill smoke test OK, telemetry sharing enabled, spike plan reviewed.
Priya (Solutions Eng): suggestion: add a tiny FAQ section with quick fixes: "if p95 spikes during ramp -> check client batching window and prefill TTLs".
Maya (CS): perfect. i'll stitch into a two-page runbook + 1-page customer checklist. i'll post draft in #customer-success for review tomorrow morning. anyone want to add anything brief now?
Alex (CS Ops): include opt-in sample for collection of anonymized telemetry (GDPR note).
Jordan (SRE): + add runbook step: if red-tier for >4h, recommend temporary routing to backup smaller model variant to preserve UX.
CS Health Bot: incident created -> ID #CS-2026-0827 -> assigned to Jordan (SRE) for playbook annotation. :robot_face: 
Maya (CS): thanks all — i'll publish draft and tag reviewers. cc @Sam (PM) for renewal checklist final wording. :thumbsup:
